scope: Pure track extraction and analytic deformation review. No implementation/website edits, browser, or server. Knot numerics exclude ambient/pointer offsets; updated ambient/deformation continuity is validated separately.
cardWidthConvention: Primary speed uses the unrotated Moon width at that knot: 1.1667 × current uniform scale. Also includes unscaled card widths/s. Neither is projected pixel speed.

validatedRendererMath.result: Ambient gain is cubic smoothstep over progress [0,.16]; both endpoint derivatives are zero, removing the earlier gain velocity break.
Bend positions are branchless polynomials in angle/bend, including zero bend. They are smooth and no longer contain a deformation threshold.

Sheet normal includes the derivative of twist angle with respect to Y: normalize(-sin(a+t), -twist*(cos(a+t)*X+sin(a+t)*Z), cos(a+t)). It is correct for the ideal analytic bend+twist; the positional polynomial creates only the quantified tiny approximation discrepancy.

qualifications.issue: Depth testing resolves visible fragments; it does not prove surfaces do not intersect. No mesh collision or intersection proof was performed.

C1 concerns authored channels and deformation at fixed layout under continuous progress/time. It does not assert continuous pixel derivatives at visibility changes or guarantee time-domain continuity for arbitrary scroll/control jumps.

bendApproximation.note: Alternating-series bounds for the exact sin/cos bend at real arithmetic; these are not GPU floating-point measurements.

shortPortrait.result: Short portrait adds a constant +.39 to all Y keys; speeds and all other channels remain unchanged within floating-point precision. It is a layout selection, not an interpolated resize transition.
